text:
Ravi: Hey finance team — I had to pay for an expedited visa fee (government portal) and same-day courier to deliver passport docs for a customer trip. Corp card declined on the gov site. Total was $210.50 on my personal card. I have the courier receipt PDF but the gov portal only shows a confirmation number, not a printable receipt. Can this be reimbursed to relocation/travel? cc @Tess (manager).

Expense-bot: Hi Ravi — policy: government fees + courier for business travel are reimbursable. Missing/limited receipts over $75 require a Lost Receipt Form + evidence (screenshot of confirmation, bank txn line). Submit at https://redwood.finance/expenses/lost-receipt and include manager approval in Concur comments.

Ravi: Uploaded courier PDF and a screenshot of the government payment confirmation to Concur. Expense submitted as EXP-6123 under cost center TR-2026. Redacted card PAN.

Tess: I approve charging TR-2026 for Ravi's expedited visa + courier for the customer trip. Tess approved 2026-04-10. Please add "Customer site: SFO 2026-04-15" in the Concur comment.

Morgan: Finance — quick checks: 1) we need the bank statement line showing $210.50, 2) attach the courier invoice with company VAT/tax number if available, 3) confirm the confirmation number for the gov payment in the Concur notes. Once those are attached we can clear.

Ravi: Attached bank txn screenshot and added the gov confirmation number (CONF-98321). Courier invoice has vendor tax no. VND-3344 attached. Submitted everything and updated Concur note per Morgan.

Expense-bot: EXP-6123 received. Status: awaiting finance review. Note: because part of expense relates to an immovable government fee, no VAT reclaim applies. Reimbursement ETA 3 business days after approval.

Morgan: Reviewing now. All docs present and PII redacted. Approving EXP-6123 and routing for payment. Reminder to open cards@redwood ticket about failures on government payment gateways so we can troubleshoot corp card routing.

Ravi: Thanks all — will open a ticket and follow up if payment doesn't post. Appreciate the quick help. :thumbsup:
